phase_name: Final gate, deferred findings, and summary

objectives.description: Run the full project gate (code/tests/ and bimodal tests, including slow A2 cases)
Run bimodal suite once with no checker resolvable and once with one, confirming both green
Record deferred findings for the certificate-wire hardening task

approaches_tried.approach: Ran full bimodal suite twice in parallel (no-checker + with-checker) to save time
approaches_tried.reason: Resource contention between the two concurrent full-suite runs produced a flaky failure in test_iterate.py's TestLiveIteration::test_a_live_run_detects_a_genuine_rotation_permutation_duplicate (assert 0 >= 1) in the with-checker run only. Re-ran that single test in isolation (passed, 17.37s) and then the full with-checker suite alone (629 passed, no failures), confirming the parallel run's failure was contention-induced, not a regression.

deviations.reason: code/tests/ci/test_timing_marker_coverage.py::test_all_wall_clock_timing_assertions_are_marked failed: tests/unit/test_checker.py::test_probe_timeout_yields_unavailable_not_a_hang reads a real time.time() and asserts elapsed < 1.0 without a performance/xdist_serial marker, even though the timed operation (_invoke) is monkeypatched to return instantly. Fixed by adding @pytest.mark.xdist_serial (the taxonomy's own 'adequate headroom, but contention-sensitive' classification) rather than adding a MOCKED_CLOCK_ALLOWLIST entry, since the marker mechanism is the more conservative, less bespoke fix for a test whose margin (1.0s bound on an always-near-zero measured value) is generous.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added @pytest.mark.xdist_serial to test_probe_timeout_yields_unavailable_not_a_hang, caught by the project-wide timing-marker-coverage gate during this phase's full-project run)*
